fato_historico: 1971: Vietnam War: Australia and New Zealand decide to withdraw their troops from Vietnam.

Consider this an ideal time to detach from old burdens and look toward the horizon. Your adventurous spirit is calling for a fresh start, so let your heart lead the way toward new, sun-drenched possibilities.
